verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's official pscale CLI documents creating, deleting and listing databases and branches. It also opens a secure MySQL/PostgreSQL shell, runs non-interactive SQL, and inspects databases through Insights commands such as top queries and listing regions. missing for 10: an explicitly documented local connect/proxy command for apps (connection is shown only via the shell), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: Create, delete and list your Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches
Open a secure MySQL or PostgreSQL shell instance
Run non-interactive SQL for agents and scripts (`pscale sql`)
Surface PlanetScale's server-side analysis of a database: aggregated query statistics, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema recommendations
List top queries ranked by a performance metric
